claims.source: P1 pp63-65 and P5 p27, native pages inspected
claims.finding: Principal interview dates the neighbor call approximately09:00, describes smoke, three men and apparent still/video recording before the second explosion, and contemporaneous JRJ-13Y plate notation. Police call was later. Detective relay is derivative.
claims.status: underlying released interview report located; no original recording/note recovered
claims.contrary_or_limit: Approximate recollection, apparent camera mode and inferred demeanor are not calibrated time, media identification or foreknowledge.
claims.next_input: Original plate note, neighbor interview, complaint/dispatch records, interview notes/recording if created, original photographs.
claims.discriminating_test: Compare independently timestamped observations without counting the detective relay as another witness.

claims.source: P1 p33; P5 pp21-22,25; P6 p49; native pages inspected
claims.finding: Separate early summary says a van was seen08:00. Maintenance observer gives both less than5 minutes after first impact and09:00-09:10, identifies an enclosed1-A diagram, and did not recognize the pictured men. claims.source: P1 p7, native layout inspected; P6 p53 closure instruction is a previously checked source
claims.finding: Item15 fabric E01889035; controls16/17 gloves/bomb suits E01889036; item34 blanket E01889037. Acquisition date09/12/2001. Labels specify residue examination purpose, not positive chemistry.
claims.status: sample/control identifiers verified; matching final chemistry unresolved

claims.source: P6 pp39,54 and P1 p35, native pages inspected
claims.finding: Closing account reports government-employment belief based on physical evidence/statements, without disclosing full item/interview/person join. One parallel paragraph names Jewish Agency where the other copy redacts wording; other roles remain differently redacted.
claims.status: reported basis and redaction variants preserved; employment/tasking independently unverified
claims.contrary_or_limit: Source reports no established US clandestine tasking/prior knowledge. Different redacted people or paragraphs cannot be equated, and Mossad cannot be supplied as an employer.
claims.next_input: Disclosed originating exhibits/interviews and an explicit employment/person/tasking crosswalk.
claims.discriminating_test: Test the actual role, time and instructions against the foreknowledge/participation propositions, without reconstructing redacted identities.
